request: How to change the inlet temperature of a flow stream?
guidance: Double-click on the inlet stream (process stream) on the flowsheet to open its properties viewer window
Double Click the 2nd cell right hand side of 'Temperature' to activate editing
Press Enter or click outside the cell to confirm the change
Close the stream properties viewr window by clicking the 'X' at the top right corner of the window
The stream will turn brown indicating it is ready for execution
take note the blue color figure in the table are editable values
